description: FinOps framework definition for the Sylvia API surface. Pay-per-request usage with crypto billing.

principles.name: Visibility
principles.description: Every successful request is metered and reflected in the account balance in near real-time.

principles.name: Allocation
principles.description: Each API key is a scoped unit of consumption, attributable to an account and a budget.

principles.name: Optimization
principles.description: Tier selection and request-format choice drive cost per useful unit of work.

principles.name: Accountability
principles.description: Keys carry an optional budget (USD cap) that halts usage when exhausted.
